release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.16 improves the owner Top/Classic header layout by pairing Owner Vault with a matching Announcements control and centering the two-card group in the middle of the top header. The Announcements card uses the same black/graphite visual language and responsive sizing as Owner Vault. In Top view it opens the existing owner announcement composer beneath the header, while Sidebar behavior remains unchanged with the full composer in the lower rail. The change reuses the existing broadcasts.write authority gate and /api/owner/broadcasts delivery path so there is still only one protected announcement pipeline. Regression coverage protects centered placement, responsive sizing, Top-view popover behavior, Sidebar preservation, and authority gating. The exact PR head passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, and CodeQL before merge and Stable promotion.
